notes: Speak-while-listening queue: speech that continues while a translation is playing is now captured and queued (max 2) and translated right after playback ends, chaining indefinitely; an echo guard + loop breaker stop the phone re-translating its own spoken output. Earphone/phone-speaker echo behaviour and chaining are phone-unproven - the diagnostic log decides. No new STT engine, no new permissions, no internal-audio capture.
